newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brierley says wants 49 pct of Fairfax.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brierley says wants 49 pct of Fairfax.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd executive director Rodney Price said on Friday that Brierley wanted to increase its current 20 percent stake in John Fairfax Holdings Ltd to up to 49 percent.
"Yes," Price told reporters when asked if Brierley wanted to increase its stake, "...up to 49 percent," he said.
Price said Brierley had yet to make an application to the government to increase its stake, but would apply later in the year.
Earlier, John Fairfax shareholders voted, on a count of proxies, against a proposal by Brierley to increase its stake in the newspaper publisher by five percent to 25 percent.
Brierley acquired the 20 percent stake from interests of Canadian media baron Conrad Black, which held a total of 25 percent.
Brierley has said it intends to be a long term holder of its stake in the newspaper company.
At 2.00 p.m (0300 GMT), Fairfax shares were two cents weaker at A$3.13.
